selection_rule: Use primary or official sources. Stable publications anchor structure; current sources are date-pinned; draft and watch sources remain visibly non-stable and cannot silently replace stable pins.

added_sources.title: On the local well-posedness of Lovelock and Horndeski theories
added_sources.version_or_date: Physical Review D 96, 044019, published 16 August 2017; arXiv:1705.04370
added_sources.evidence_role: primary methodological evidence that strong hyperbolicity is a necessary well-posedness obligation in the studied theory classes; not proof that GMUT is well posed or empirically valid

added_sources.title: Checking for prior-data conflict
added_sources.evidence_role: primary methodological source for distinguishing prior-data conflict from sampling-model failure; not a real-data GMUT analysis

added_sources.title: Guidelines for Reporting Reliability and Agreement Studies were proposed
added_sources.evidence_role: primary consensus reporting guidance distinguishing reliability and agreement; not a completed THOS rating study or trial

added_sources.title: Server-Side Request Forgery Prevention Cheat Sheet
added_sources.evidence_role: official defensive guidance for outbound URL validation and network-target restrictions; not proof of Freed ID production security

added_sources.title: NIST IR 8397: Guidelines on Minimum Standards for Developer Verification of Software
added_sources.authority: National Institute of Standards and Technology
added_sources.version_or_date: Final, October 2021; official publication status checked 14 July 2026
added_sources.evidence_role: official minimum verification guidance including fuzzing and historical tests; explicitly not the totality of software verification or exhaustive security

added_sources.title: SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH specification
added_sources.evidence_role: primary project specification for deterministic build timestamps; not independent reproduction or complete hermeticity

added_sources.title: On the Theory of Scales of Measurement
added_sources.evidence_role: primary historical classification of nominal, ordinal, interval, and ratio scales and admissible transformations; not empirical validation of thermo-psyche analogies

added_sources.title: Decentralized Identifier Resolution v0.3
added_sources.version_or_date: W3C Working Draft, 10 July 2026; feature-at-risk and work-in-progress status retained
added_sources.evidence_role: current draft context for resolver interfaces, redirects, query normalization, security, and privacy considerations; not a stable Recommendation or production conformance result

boundary: The effective ledger is provenance, not validation of GMUT, THOS superiority, Freed ID deployment, legal interpretation, cultural ratification, Māori authority, Māori data governance, security completeness, accessibility conformance, consciousness, personhood, or independent reproduction.
